newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank's first-half settlements up sharply.
newsitem.headline: China bank's first-half settlements up sharply.

text.p: The Jiangxi branch of the Construction Bank of China alone saw its foreign exchange settlements business surge to $397 million in the first half from $60.5 million in the year-ago period, state media said on Wednesday.
The Financial Morning Post linked the rise in the bank's international settlement volume to expanded service focusing on large-scale enterprises. It gave no further details.
